_doc: GENERATED by tools/suzunari_theme.py from data/tips.json + data/suzunari/_manual/tips.json. Edit those, not this.

first_planet.title: SUZUNARI REMEMBERS
first_planet.touch: Everyone here notices what you do, and tells everyone else. Walk up to anyone and tap the middle button to talk. Amane is always somewhere behind you.
first_planet.pad: Everyone here notices what you do, and tells everyone else. Walk up to anyone and press Y to talk. Amane is always somewhere behind you.
first_planet.key: Everyone here notices what you do, and tells everyone else. Walk up to anyone and press F to talk. Amane is always somewhere behind you.

combat.title: FIGHT SMART
combat.touch: MELEE when a foe is 3-9 m away = DASH STRIKE. ROLL through shots. Shooters stop to reload after each burst - that's your opening.
combat.pad: X with a foe 3-9 m away = DASH STRIKE. A to roll through shots. Shooters stop to reload after a burst - go in then.
combat.key: J with a foe 3-9 m away = DASH STRIKE. SPACE to roll through shots. Shooters stop to reload after a burst - go in then.

parry.title: PARRY
parry.touch: Tap PARRY just before a hit lands: bolts fly back at double damage and brutes stagger.
parry.pad: RB just before a hit lands: bolts fly back at double damage and brutes stagger.
parry.key: L just before a hit lands: bolts fly back at double damage and brutes stagger.

parts.title: BREAK THEIR GEAR
parts.touch: Tap an enemy's part (legs, weapon, jetpack) to aim at it. Broken legs slow them, broken weapons disarm them.
parts.pad: LT picks an enemy part to aim at. Broken legs slow them, broken weapons disarm them.
parts.key: Q picks an enemy part to aim at. Broken legs slow them, broken weapons disarm them.

witness.title: SOMEONE IS CALLING PARAGON
witness.touch: A witness is on the phone about you. Reach them before the bar fills: pay, charm or scare them. Or just leave fast.
witness.pad: A witness is on the phone about you. Reach them before the bar fills (Y): pay, charm or scare them.
witness.key: A witness is on the phone about you. Reach them before the bar fills (F): pay, charm or scare them.

labels.title: THEY REMEMBER
labels.touch: Tags over heads show how people feel about you. Friends give gifts and won't report you. Enemies complain to the police.
labels.pad: Tags over heads show how people feel about you. Friends give gifts and won't report you. Enemies complain to the police.
labels.key: Tags over heads show how people feel about you. Friends give gifts and won't report you. Enemies complain to the police.

shops.title: OWNERS REMEMBER TOO
shops.touch: The owner by the door is the same person every visit. Treat them well and prices drop. Wreck the place and you're banned.
shops.pad: The owner by the door is the same person every visit. Treat them well and prices drop. Wreck the place and you're banned.
shops.key: The owner by the door is the same person every visit. Treat them well and prices drop. Wreck the place and you're banned.

weapons.title: NEW WEAPON
weapons.touch: Swap weapons with the BLADE and GUN buttons.
weapons.pad: Swap weapons: L3 = blade, R3 = gun.

medkit.title: LOW HEALTH
medkit.touch: Tap MED to use a medkit. Clinics and street traders sell more.
medkit.pad: Use a medkit from the menu (START > ITEMS). Clinics sell more.
medkit.key: Use a medkit from the menu (ESC > ITEMS). Clinics sell more.

overclock.title: OVERCLOCK READY
overclock.touch: BOOST spends a bar: you move, hit and fire faster for a few seconds.
overclock.pad: B spends a bar: you move, hit and fire faster for a few seconds.
overclock.key: R spends a bar: you move, hit and fire faster for a few seconds.

air.title: AIR ISN'T FREE
air.touch: You're billed for breathing. Unpaid air becomes debt - and the bank collects. Pay at an AIR kiosk or loan office.
air.pad: You're billed for breathing. Unpaid air becomes debt - and the bank collects. Pay at an AIR kiosk or loan office.
air.key: You're billed for breathing. Unpaid air becomes debt - and the bank collects. Pay at an AIR kiosk or loan office.

riot.title: RIOT SHIELD
riot.touch: Shots from the front bounce off. Flank them, PARRY their swing, charge a shot, or blow them up.
riot.pad: Shots from the front bounce off. Flank them, parry their swing, charge a shot, or blow them up.
riot.key: Shots from the front bounce off. Flank them, parry their swing, charge a shot, or blow them up.

boom.title: AD-BOMB BOT
boom.touch: It runs at you and explodes. Shoot it first - near its friends.
boom.pad: It runs at you and explodes. Shoot it first - near its friends.
boom.key: It runs at you and explodes. Shoot it first - near its friends.

choices.title: PEOPLE ANSWER BACK
choices.touch: What you do to someone has a result - and they may push back. The blue lines show what changed.
choices.pad: What you do to someone has a result - and they may push back. The blue lines show what changed.
choices.key: What you do to someone has a result - and they may push back. The blue lines show what changed.
